AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >
  Benchmark application for the thesis "Cross-Layer Context for LLM-Based Detection and
  Root-Cause Analysis of Configuration Anomalies in AWS Lambda". Four SeBS functions
  (Table 3.2). This template is the intended state of the application.

Globals:
  Function:
    Runtime: python3.12
    Architectures: [x86_64]
    Tracing: PassThrough
    LoggingConfig:
      LogFormat: Text

Resources:
  # --------

input.query_string: fields @timestamp, @logStream, @message | filter @message like /(?i)(error|exception|accessdenied|not authorized|timeout|task timed out|memory)/ | sort @timestamp desc | limit 50

fields @timestamp, @message | filter @message not like /^REPORT/ and @message not like /^START/ and @message not like /^END/ | filter @message like /(?i)(ERROR|Exception|AccessDenied|not authorized|Task timed out|Traceback|WARN)/ | sort @timestamp desc | limit 30
